text:
EGLAMOUR:
  This is the hour Madam Silvia asked me to come and find out what she wants.
  There's something important she needs me for.
  Madam, madam!
  (Silvia appears above.)
SILVIA:
  Who's there?
EGLAMOUR:
  Your servant and your friend.
  Someone who's here to do whatever your ladyship asks.
SILVIA:
  Sir Eglamour, a thousand good mornings to you.
EGLAMOUR:
  And as many to you, my noble lady.
  Just as your ladyship asked, I've come this early
  to find out what you'd like me to do for you.
